correctness.rationale: PASS. The claim is a complete finite classification of labeled rank-3 positroid supports in Gr_C(3,6), not isomorphism classes. Decorated permutations and cyclic Grassmann-necklace Gale tests give 883 supports; regular iff binary by the cited positroid theorems, and a basis-normalized F2 representation has every off-pivot entry uniquely fixed by exchange minors. Independent from the package primary route, enumerated all 1395 three-dimensional F2 row spaces in RREF and tested their full 20-subset basis supports against all six cyclic Gale inequalities. Obtained exactly 703 distinct binary positroid supports. Independently calculated the matroid components via exchanges and Johnson-graph basis degree: distribution by (dimension,smooth) is (0,T):20,(1,T):90,(2,T):180,(3,T):95,(3,F):120,(4,T):6,(4,F):144,(5,F):48. Thus 391 smooth and 312 singular toric, 180 nonregular. This is exhaustive by proven finite parametrization; geometric interpretation relies on cited toricity and fixed-point smoothness theorems.
